name: Souma Naito
source:
Shinichiro's classmate and roommate.

He has a well-developed face, but his baby face makes him look cute rather than cool. His voice is high and cute, and inside he is just as childish as his appearance.

His grandfather instilled in him the spirit of chivalry, and he always acts in accordance with the spirit of chivalry. In particular, he was taught to “Be kind to women! He gives useless advice to Shinichiro, who is not very good with girls. He is very motivated, but basically runs on empty.

[From [url=https://www.pulltop.com/gp07/02_chara10-01.html]official site[/url]]
